text: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), a research-supported type of psychotherapy, is commonly used to treat GAD. CBT helps people become aware of automatic ways of thinking that are inaccurate or harmful and then question those thoughts, understand how the thoughts affect their emotions and behavior, and change self-defeating behavior patterns to feel less anxious and worried. CBT has been well studied and is the “gold standard” choice for psychotherapy.
